body.name: Observable one-collision sign certificate
body.construction: Order \(y\) as displayed in \(\mathrm{def:ten-variable-system}\). For each \(s\), apply Collins projection recursively: at each coordinate adjoin all coefficients, leading coefficients, discriminants, pairwise resultants, and signed principal subresultant coefficients of every equality against every inequality boundary in \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}\), then delete that coordinate. Adjoin the three collision minors and the two collided-row box numerators. To test target constancy, for every \(s'\) and \(\sigma'\in\Sigma\), form a second copy \(y'\), impose both branch systems, and adjoin the cleared strict inequality \(\sum_{t=3}^{4}[\tau_t(\operatorname{rec}_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,y);P)-\tau_t(\operatorname{rec}_{k_0,s',\sigma'}(P,y');P)]^2>0\). Project every coordinate in \(y,y'\), leaving polynomials only in the observable cells of \(P\) and \(\eta\). The finite list \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}(P,\eta)\) is the union of these feasibility and nonconstancy projection polynomials over all eight \(s\). Its certificate records the sign of every member and the signed Sturm--Habicht lifting table, including zero cells. Feasibility and equality of both ATT coordinates across all branches are decided by exact sign-invariant lifting, with a retained sample point or a first violated sign attached to every decision.
